pt-BR.prompt: Long a {entry}, stop em {stop}, alvo em {target}. Quantos R o alvo vale?
pt-BR.explain: R é o ganho até o alvo dividido pelo risco até o stop: ({target} − {entry}) / ({entry} − {stop}) = {gain} / {dist} = {answer}.

en.prompt: A long at {entry}, stop at {stop}, target at {target}. How many R is the target worth?
en.explain: R is the gain to the target divided by the risk to the stop: ({target} − {entry}) / ({entry} − {stop}) = {gain} / {dist} = {answer}.
